stem: In which set do all the figures appear to be either a rhombus, parallelogram, trapezoid, rectangle, or square?
visual_elements: Set F: parallelogram, rectangle, parallelogram, trapezoid shapes
Set G: rectangle, square, rhombus, trapezoid shapes
Set H: square, rhombus, irregular quadrilateral, parallelogram shapes
Set J: square, concave shape, trapezoid, irregular quadrilateral shapes
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding and classifying different quadrilaterals and identifying which set completely fits the category, involving modest reasoning about geometric figures.
